question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s consolidated authority within the Chinese Communist Party and military underpins trader expectations that he will remain in office through 2026. Extensive anti-corruption purges of senior officials, including Politburo and Central Military Commission figures, have removed potential rivals and aligned top ranks with his priorities without visible challenges to his leadership. No successor has been designated, and official preparations focus on the 21st National Congress scheduled for late 2027, where Xi is widely expected to secure a fourth term as general secretary. Recent analyses note continuity in elite networks loyal to Xi alongside generational turnover below the top level, with the “seven up, eight down” retirement norm applying mainly to others. Absent any reported health events, factional revolt, or procedural shifts before year-end, market pricing reflects the structural barriers to early removal.
